selection.eligible_repository: complete public observation with exact head SHA
selection.order: sha256(seed + repository_full_name), positions 11 through 20 per language
selection.stopping_rule: Collect all 60 non-overlapping extension repositories and aggregate with phase 1. Do not stop when thresholds or favorable outcomes are reached.

aggregation.overlap_policy: any repeated repository or pull request is a hard error

collection.stored_review_evidence: public URL, author class, timestamp, state, resolution, category and sha256 body digest

classification.review_intervention: human review artifact contains a frozen category term and a directive marker
classification.blocking_intervention: eligible pull request review has state CHANGES_REQUESTED
classification.resolved_intervention: eligible review-thread comment belongs to a resolved thread
classification.maintainer_action_proxy: resolved_intervention and pull request merged after the comment; this is not causal proof
classification.business_relevant_proxy: blocking intervention, or actionable security/permissions, reliability/edge-case, or API-contract/docs intervention
classification.current_aos_alignment_proxy: tests intervention in a repository classified by the frozen corpus as coverage_gap_candidate
classification.limitations: Final merged history cannot reconstruct what checks failed before merge, prove that AOS would have changed a decision, or establish causality. Keyword classification may contain false positives and false negatives.

verdict_rule: The combined two-phase result is evaluated once after every extension repository is collected. PROXY_SUPPORT_CURRENT_VALUE requires every threshold. REAL_PAIN_FOUND_AOS_GAP means actionable pain meets threshold but current AOS alignment does not. INSUFFICIENT_PROXY_SAMPLE means either combined sample threshold fails. No proxy result can produce mass-market GO or causal product claims.
